title: 第158章 旭宸归葬启神脑三姝入怀回冥域第157章 不想双修只需让她瞧瞧我的肾
content_zh:
“七曜命轮”旁辉光一闪，传送通道再次凭空浮现。
这是催我回去？
还是指引我去找凰青？
大谨巾的下落还没确认，我暂时不能走。
真要走，至少也得等旭宸分身入土为安。
何况芙曲早已与我结下“同心引契”，因果牵系，我总得想办法带她一起走。
我搭了搭她的脉搏，各项体征都很平稳，好端端的怎么会突然昏迷？
难道“同心引契”连改造人大脑也能影响，直接搅乱了她的思绪？
这也太匪夷所思了，她不过是瞥到了我肾脏上的绿色凤凰印记而已。
“哥哥，说不定是我骤然离开她的身体，她一时适应不了才晕过去的。”凰绿在旁轻声猜测。
“你原先附在她身上什么位置？”
“我是以‘信息’状态存在的，原先应该依附在她的脑海里。”
“改造人的大脑也有‘脑海’这种说法？”
“是她的原生大脑。”
“多维躯体？”
“可以这么理解。在我的感知里，她的大脑和肉身一直维持着某种超越物理维度的同步联结。”
“那你还能回到她身体里去吗？”
“可以。”
话音刚落，一道温润的内息顺着我的经脉渡出，渗入芙曲的肌肤之下。
几乎是同一瞬，她睫毛轻颤，缓缓睁开了眼，怔怔地望着我。

不对劲。
怎么瞧着她的眼神，像是根本不认得我了？
愣了好半晌，她才满脸疑惑地开口：“我刚才是不是摔了一跤，把脑子摔坏了？怎么看你浑身都泛着绿光，头顶还亮得特别显眼？”
“能把你的视角共享给我看看吗？”
“好呀。”
她当即通过“智脑”把第一视角同步推送给了我。
我心里咯噔一下。
我居然真的浑身上下都在往外冒绿光。
这什么情况？
在芙曲的视角里，那绿光像液态翡翠似的在我皮肤表面缓缓流淌，可我自己低头却什么都看不见。
更奇妙的是，这道绿光还能跟着我的意念随意流转。
我试着运转“基础调息”。
运转之下，经脉间格外通透顺畅。
嗯？我身后怎么也有一团亮得刺眼的绿光？
我侧身挪开半步，才看清源头——竟是我那颗肾脏在发光，上面的绿色凤凰印记亮得格外醒目。
“哥哥，我现在能介入那颗肾脏了。”菁琎的声音忽然在我脑海里响起。
话音未落，她的气息便消失不见，整个人钻入了那颗肾脏之中。
肉眼可见地，那颗肾脏上先钻出纤细却力道十足的两条手臂与两条腿，跟着展开一对薄翼，最后还冒出两个米粒大小的眼睛。
紧接着，肾脏径直脱离培养皿飘了起来，稳稳落在我掌心。
content_en:
There was a flash of light next to the "Qi Yao Life Wheel", and the transmission channel appeared out of thin air again.
Is this urging me to go back?
Or guide me to find Huang Qing?
The whereabouts of Da Jinjin have not yet been confirmed, so I can’t leave for the time being.
If he really wanted to leave, he would at least have to wait until Xu Chen's clone was buried.
What's more, Fuqu has already formed a "sympathy bond" with me. Cause and effect are linked, so I have to find a way to take her with me.
I checked her pulse, and all signs were stable. How could she suddenly fall into coma if she was fine?
Could it be that "Togetherness" can even affect the transformation of people's brains, directly disrupting her thoughts?
This is too incredible, she just caught a glimpse of the green phoenix mark on my kidney.
"Brother, maybe she fainted because she couldn't adapt to my sudden departure from her body." Huang Lu guessed softly from the side.
"Where did you originally attach yourself to her?"
"I exist in an 'information' state, and I should have been attached to her mind."
"Is there also a term for 'brain' in modifying a person's brain?"
"It's her native brain."
"Multidimensional body?"
"It can be understood this way. In my perception, her brain and body have always maintained some kind of synchronous connection that transcends the physical dimension."
"Then can you still go back into her body?"
"Okay."
As soon as I finished speaking, a warm inner breath flowed out along my meridians and penetrated under Fuqu's skin.
Almost at the same moment, her eyelashes trembled slightly, she slowly opened her eyes, and looked at me blankly.
Something is wrong.
Why is it that she looks at her like she doesn't recognize me at all?
After being stunned for a long time, she said with confusion on her face: "Did I fall just now and break my brain? Why do you see that your whole body is glowing with green light, and the top of your head is so bright?"
"Can you share your perspective with me?"
"Okay."
She immediately pushed the first-person perspective to me through "Zhi Nao".
My heart skipped a beat.
I actually had green light coming out from all over my body.
What's going on?
From Fuqu's perspective, the green light flowed slowly on the surface of my skin like liquid emerald, but I couldn't see anything when I lowered my head.
What's even more amazing is that this green light can flow freely with my thoughts.
I tried running "Basic Pranayama".
Under operation, the meridians are exceptionally transparent and smooth.
Um? Why is there a blinding green light behind me?
I moved half a step sideways and saw the source clearly - it was my kidney that was glowing, and the green phoenix mark on it was particularly eye-catching.
"Brother, I can intervene in that kidney now." Jingjing's voice suddenly sounded in my mind.
Before she finished speaking, her breath disappeared, and her whole body penetrated into the kidney.
Visible to the naked eye, two slender but powerful arms and legs first emerged from the kidney, then a pair of thin wings spread out, and finally two eyes the size of rice grains emerged.
Immediately afterwards, the kidney separated directly from the petri dish, floated up, and landed firmly in my palm.
